title: Chapter 1: The Childhood Friends Who Became Idols and the Transfer Student Who Brings a Storm 2
content: The man in black, saluting Ijuuin, immediately picked up the desk and dashed out of the classroom.
It couldn’t have taken a minute; it was all over in an instant. We could only watch in silence.
By the way, Gotou-kun was known for leaving his books and notes in his desk, but no one mentioned that.
With the rapid succession of events, our heads couldn’t keep up.
In the now chaotic classroom, a small cough echoed softly.
“…Well then, let’s start again. Is this truly Setsuna-sama’s desk? It exudes a noble aura that is completely different from the previous desk. Thank you for letting me know. What is your name?”
“Hmm? Me? I’m Kuzuhara Kazuma.”
I reflexively answered when suddenly asked for my name.
Well, it wasn’t something I needed to hide, so I didn’t mind sharing my name.
“I see. Then, Kazuma-sama. I will express my gratitude to you later. Now, drool… So, this time…!”
As Ijuuin flailed her arms and prepared to leap onto Setsuna’s desk, the classroom door opened once more.
“Whoa!?”
“Good morning, everyone!”
With a loud crash, the door swung open, and once again, Yuki-chan was hit in the face, letting out a squashed frog-like voice.
But without caring about that, the bright greeting that cut through the chaotic atmosphere came from my childhood friend, Takanashi Setsuna, who was an active high school idol.
The arrival of the idol was truly a saving grace for the students of Class 2-D.
The dreadful atmosphere caused by Ijuuin’s presence was cleansed as soon as Setsuna appeared.
“Good morning, Takanashi-san!”
“You saved us!”
“You were late today! Was it because of yesterday’s live performance?”
It was as if time had resumed in the previously silent classroom, with voices of greeting for Setsuna echoing from all corners, each laced with a sense of relief.
It was as if a savior had arrived. It was no wonder everyone wanted to join in on this flow. Even if they didn’t voice it, the class’s consensus was clear.
“Yeah, I stayed at a hotel last night, so my manager dropped me off today. That’s why I’m a bit late.”
Setsuna replied to her classmates, who seemed to be seeking salvation, without a hint of displeasure.
“Ugh, that hurt… Do I have a face that can get married…?”
“And I’m sorry to you, teacher. I didn’t expect you to be there. I think I bumped into the door; are you okay?”
“Y-Yeah. I’m fine… Ugh, Takanashi-san is such a good girl. The others just ignore me or don’t show me respect. I feel like I might cry from being treated so kindly…”
“Ahaha. You’re exaggerating, teacher. Here, I’ll give you some healing ointment. I hope the red part heals quickly.”
“T-Takanashi-san…! The angel is right here…!”
After smiling at Yuki-chan, who seemed to be moved to tears, Setsuna stepped further into the classroom.
She was just walking, but she exuded a charm that set her apart from others.
Having grown significantly since childhood, Setsuna was still a bit taller, and her hair flowed down her back, matching her growth.
Her figure was distinct from the other students, rivaling that of a model. In fact, several girls sighed in admiration, confirming that she was an exceptional presence even from a female perspective.
Of course, her looks were extraordinary, befitting an idol, with perfectly symmetrical facial features.
Though still a high school student and thus somewhat unfinished, she boasted a beauty akin to a work of art, incomparable to ordinary girls. No, it would be rude to even compare.
Before this beautiful girl, who was an object of admiration for everyone, I casually called out to her.
“Hey, Setsuna. Good morning!”
“Ah, Kaz-kun! Good morning!”
Setsuna smiled at me and approached.
Now that I was consciously aware of it, I realized her features were sculpted like a statue.
Yet her expression was soft and human, devoid of any artificial coldness. Rather, it was warm, captivating anyone who looked at her.
She truly embodied the perfect beautiful girl that everyone envied.
Setsuna was undoubtedly a girl born to become an idol.
“Ah, ahh! Is that really the real Setsuna-sama!? So beautiful! A perfect human is right here!!??”
By the way, Ijuuin, who seemed to be a die-hard fan of “Damenz,” was flapping her mouth and muttering something in a rapid-fire manner, as if she had glitched.
It was likely because she was seeing the real Setsuna up close, but I decided to ignore it.
There was no benefit in poking a hornet’s nest. In such situations, it was best to remain silent.
“The live performance yesterday was amazing. It’s been highly praised, and everyone’s raving about it online.”
“Really? Did you think so too, Kaz-kun?”
“Of course. From my perspective, it was an incredible performance. Arisa was shining too. You did great.”
“Hehe, I’m so happy to hear that since I worked hard yesterday.”
When I complimented her, Setsuna blushed and smiled shyly.
If I didn’t have any resistance, that smile would have knocked me out instantly.
Setting aside my bias as her childhood friend, I truly thought she was cute.
Being able to receive a smile directly from someone like her meant I was undoubtedly a lucky guy— in many ways.
“Yeah, keep working hard. If you do, you’ll earn a lot. That way, you’ll be on the winning side of life.”
“Mmm. Kaz-kun, that’s a bit harsh. My fans are seriously supporting me.”
Setsuna scolded me lightly.
“I have to meet those expectations. I plan to keep working hard, without any excuses. So, you shouldn’t say things like that, even if it’s Kaz-kun, okay?”
She had an attitude like a mother scolding a child who did something wrong. Was she trying to be a mother or something?
Well, she lacked any real intensity, so it was clear she didn’t intend to scold me seriously. In fact, I had no memory of ever being scolded by Setsuna.
On the other hand, I had plenty of memories of being scolded by Arisa. This caring childhood friend was exceedingly sweet to me.
“Exactly! You’re right, Takanashi-san. As expected, you say such good things…”
It seemed like Sayama was nodding along, perhaps feeling moved.
Oh right, he was here. I had completely forgotten with all the intense characters around. It had been a chaotic morning.
“What a precious thing… wonderful…”
“I can support this.”
“I think I could go for Setsuna-chan even as a girl.”
Looking around, I noticed that everyone was looking at Setsuna with the same respectful gaze as Sayama.
It seemed that Setsuna’s exemplary response as an idol had caused her popularity to soar in various places.
Voices of admiration were rising throughout the classroom.
While I confirmed this with a sideways glance, I bowed my head to Setsuna.
“Sorry, sorry. I was just teasing. You’re serious about being an idol, huh?”
Of course, I was secretly chuckling to myself. If Setsuna could gain popularity from such things, it was an easy win.
“Hehe. That’s right. I’m glad you understand.”
“Yeah. I’ll be careful from now on. So, about the main topic…”
I was ready to take the plunge, willing to take on any mud that came my way.
Because—
“Did you bring the money for this month?”
“Yeah! I just withdrew it. Here you go! This is this month’s allowance!”
After all, it would eventually lead to my benefit.
Seeing the envelope presented with a beaming smile from Setsuna, I couldn’t help but smile back.
“Oh! Thank you! You have no idea how much this helps me every month. Now I can roll the gacha to my heart’s content!”
Ignoring the sudden silence that fell over the classroom, I expressed my gratitude.
While I didn’t think they had forgotten, it still felt great to receive it directly like this.
If I could savor the feel of this envelope, becoming a villain was a trivial matter.
(Hahaha, with this much, I can easily max out the gacha.)

Normally, I would receive this thick envelope at home, but today was the day a new character rumored to have a strength class of human rights was being implemented in the social game I was playing, and I wanted to get my hands on it as quickly as possible.
[img]https://i.imgur.com/Fk8Kq6u.jpeg
As I asked for the iTones Card to be delivered at school so I could splurge on them at the convenience store on my way home, I couldn't help but think it was a clever move on my part.
"Hehe, last month we had a live performance, and I got quite a few, so I decided to splurge this time, okay? If you run out of money or want something else, just let me know, alright?"
"Oh? Is that really okay!?"
"Of course! If it's your request, Kazukun, I'll do anything for you!"
"Hoho!"
Now that's something to be happy about. No need to hold back then. Following her suggestion, I decided to ask for what I wanted from my Childhood Friend.
"Well, I'll say it then. I want a new smartphone. I want to upgrade to the latest model coming out soon. Can you cover it?"
"Eh? Didn't you just replace it when we played together last time? Isn't it a bit too soon?"
"Come on, the design is just so good. I can't help but want it! Please, I'm begging you. I'll make it up to you somehow... if I can."
Setsuna hesitated at my request. That was a natural reaction anyone would think.
But I knew this Childhood Friend of mine would never turn down my request.
"Hmm... But..."
"See! I'm serious! I really want it! Please, Setsuna-san! I'm begging you!"
I put my hands together and asked again with a charming attitude.
Of course, I wasn't genuinely asking. I had made such requests many times before. It was a blatant act that would normally be seen through. Even a child wouldn't be fooled by it.
But Setsuna was different. She looked at me and sighed softly.
"Well, if you ask me that much, I guess I have no choice."
"Oh, then!"
"Okay. Let's go buy it together next time, alright? I'll be getting one too, so let's get matching ones!"
What a wonderful thing to say. This is what it means to have a Childhood Friend. I'm truly grateful.
"That's my Setsuna! You get it—"
"Wait a minute!"
Just as I was about to praise Setsuna with a cheerful mood, a sudden interruption came.
Turning my gaze, I saw the confused expression of the Transfer Student.
"What is it, Ijuuin? We're in the middle of something good here, so please don't interrupt."
"Ah, I'm sorry... No, that's not it! Kazu-ma-sama! What are you saying to Setsuna-sama!?"
The Transfer Student, who had suddenly barged into our conversation, made me frown, and it seemed Setsuna felt the same way.
I glanced at the flashy girl who called my name, her eyes momentarily losing their sparkle.
"Kazu-ma-sama...? Setsuna, what's going on? Who is this girl? When did you get close to someone I don't know?"
She bombarded me with questions. I was slightly taken aback by my Childhood Friend's unusual demeanor, but there was nothing shameful about it.
"Huh? Oh, you didn't know, Setsuna? This is the Transfer Student who just joined our class today. Her name is..."
"Ijuuin Reika! I'm from the Dimension Stars! Fan Club No. 007! I'm one of the biggest fans of Damenz and, of course, Setsuna-sama! Oh, Setsuna-sama! I've always wanted to meet you!"
I tried to answer honestly, but Ijuuin jumped in front of Setsuna.
Her movements were flawless, not leaving a single moment of hesitation. Caught off guard, I missed my chance to speak.

"The first single of Damenz, Absolute Support Declaration!... Ever since I heard that divine song, I haven't been able to get Damenz out of my head for even a moment! At that moment, I felt a shock and an electric current run through my entire body! And I realized! This song, no, my encounter with Damenz is my destiny! My mission in life is to make Dimension Stars! the number one idol unit in Japan, no, the world! Since realizing that, I've been supporting Damenz with all my strength and devotion, and at the same time, I've been in love with Setsuna-sama! But that wasn't enough, so I used the power of the Ijuuin conglomerate to trace Setsuna-sama's history, and I even transferred schools... I'm so sorry! I just wanted to be close to you, my lady!"
Ijuuin confessed her stalker-like feelings all at once, tears streaming down her face as if she were overwhelmed.
Setsuna, the person being confessed to, must have been utterly confused.
Her eyes were indeed swimming, and it was clear she was quite troubled.
"Um, thank you...?"

"No! That's just my selfish behavior! Of course, I apologize for the trouble I've caused. From now on, I will support Damenz with all the power of the Ijuuin conglomerate! I won't spare any effort or money! First, let's become the number one idol unit in Japan, and then we will soar to the world! We will make the names Dimension Stars! and Setsuna known worldwide! And eventually, we will become the number one idol in the world! You are meant to be that person! No, if you don't become that, then the world is wrong!!!"
Ijuuin was completely excited. Her eyes were wild. She was like a devoted servant who had met her beloved master.
Naturally, Setsuna and all our classmates were taken aback once again.
But I decided to speak to Ijuuin, despite her current state. There was something I was curious about.
"Is Ijuuin from the Ijuuin conglomerate? That's one of the world's top conglomerates, right?"
The Ijuuin conglomerate is famous not just in Japan but globally as one of the largest corporations.

They have a wide range of businesses, from industry and finance to healthcare and entertainment, and it's said that there isn't a day when you don't see their name in TV commercials. It's even said that there isn't a company in Japan that isn't influenced by the Ijuuin family, so their scale is well-known.

At that level, money creates more money, and it seems like they live in a world where money flows in endlessly without doing anything. It's safe to say they have enough wealth to live comfortably for generations to come.
If the daughter of such a super-rich family is backing Damenz, then the future of Damenz is practically guaranteed to be bright.
"Yes, that's correct... But you! What kind of request are you making to Setsuna-sama!"
"Huh?"
"I won't let you forget what you said earlier! What was that! To beg Setsuna-sama like a beggar...! What is your relationship with Setsuna-sama!?"
Ijuuin raised her voice, demanding an answer. She was quite fierce, but what could I say?
"What do you mean by relationship? Setsuna and I are just Childhood Friends. I'm just asking her for some pocket money to buy a smartphone, right? There's nothing strange about that."
Since I became an idol, I've been receiving "pocket money" from Setsuna every month.
If she's offering it, it would be rude to refuse, and it's only natural to accept it with gratitude, right?
I promised her, and as a Childhood Friend who supports her activities as an idol, I think it's my rightful privilege to receive that money.
"Hey, Setsuna thinks so too, right?"
"Yeah. I don't see any problem with it."

"No, no, no! There's a huge problem! It's strange! Why are you asking Takanashi-san for that? You should just tell your parents to buy you a new smartphone! Even if you're Childhood Friends, asking someone else, especially a classmate, is absolutely not okay!"
Setsuna agreed with my opinion, but now Sayama jumped in from the side.
What the heck is going on with everyone? Don't they know common sense?
Faced with the unreasonable questioning from my classmates, I couldn't help but let out a sigh.

"What are you talking about? There's no way my parents would buy me one. My parents are stingy. Even when Setsuna bought me one last time, they called me from overseas during their transfer just to scold me, you know? They said not to bother such a good girl."
"Well, of course they'd say that! Takanashi-san shouldn't be buying you anything! You shouldn't be spending money you earned as an idol on someone else!"
"That's right! Setsuna-sama shouldn't be giving money to a guy! You don't need to pander to him! You are the center of Damenz, and you stand at the top of the idol world, commanding everything!"
